description: Canonical label taxonomy for the Riptide labeling bot. All label names, colors, descriptions, and per-repo component mappings.

shared_labels.description: Labels valid on every repo. Dimensions: type/, priority/, scope/, status/, bot/.

type.description: Nature of the change or request

type/bug.description: Something isn't working — fix, bugfix, hotfix

type/test.description: Test additions, changes, or test infrastructure

priority/critical.description: Security, data loss, crash loop, P0-equivalent

priority/high.description: Major feature broken, no workaround, P1-equivalent

scope.description: Blast radius / impact size measured by lines changed

status/blocked.description: Blocked on external dependency or decision

status/draft.description: PR is in draft state or marked WIP

status/reviewed.description: Has received at least one human review pass

bot/labeled.description: Bot has applied labels to this item (dedup guard)

bot/mislabeled.description: Human flagged that the bot's labels were wrong

repo_components.description: Per-repo comp/* mappings. Each repo has its own component labels derived from file paths.

comp/github-app.description: GitHub App plumbing: JWT auth, webhook server, installation sync

comp/companion.description: Bot 1: PR companion TL;DR, ELI5, emoji classification

comp/deepthink.description: Bot 2: Cron-pumped Hermes deep-think PR reviews

comp/proofshot.description: Bot 3: Cron-pumped Playwright visual verification captures

comp/labeler.description: Bot 4: Labeling engine — this file, labeler.py, labeler_test.py

comp/reporter.description: Result reporting, output formatting, PR comment posting

comp/ui.description: Svelte frontend components, pages, CSS, static assets

comp/extensions.description: Extension system, plugin hooks, extension settings

comp/gateway.description: AI provider gateway, model routing, SSE chunking

comp/workspace.description: Workspace management, git integration, file tools

comp/deploy.description: Docker, Nix, deployment scripts, CI/CD configs

comp/agent.description: Core agent runtime: loop, agent_init, prompt builder, responses endpoint

comp/cli.description: CLI entry point, hermes_cli/, setup wizard

preserved_legacy_labels.description: Default GitHub labels that coexist with the new taxonomy. These are human-assigned only (bot never auto-applies).

labels.name: question
labels.reason: Support signal, not a type/ change

labels_to_remove.description: Default GitHub labels replaced by type/* taxonomy. Bot removes these on repo setup.

classification_rules.description: Deterministic rules for label assignment. Applied before AI fallback.

type.label: type/bug
type.rule: title starts with 'fix:' OR title contains 'bug'|'bugfix'|'hotfix'|'regression' OR issue body contains 'steps to reproduce' (case-insensitive)

type.label: type/feature
type.rule: title starts with 'feat:' OR title contains 'feature'|'add'|'new' (not as prefix of another word)

type.label: type/docs
type.rule: title starts with 'docs:' OR all changed files are .md / .rst / docs/ path

type.label: type/refactor
type.rule: title starts with 'refactor:'|'chore:' OR title contains 'restructure'|'reorganize'

type.label: type/perf
type.rule: title starts with 'perf:' OR title contains 'performance'|'optimize'|'speed'|'latency'

type.label: type/test
type.rule: title starts with 'test:' OR all changed files are in test/ or *_test.* / *.test.* or *_spec.*

type.label: type/ci
type.rule: title starts with 'ci:' OR changed files are exclusively .github/ or Dockerfile*

type.label: type/deps
type.rule: title starts with 'deps:'|'depend:' OR changed files are only requirements.*, package.*, Cargo.*, go.mod, go.sum, pyproject.toml

priority.label: priority/high
priority.rule: title/body contains 'crash'|'down'|'blocking'|'broken'|'regression' OR scope is 'scope/massive' OR assigned to current milestone

priority.label: priority/medium
priority.rule: >200 lines changed OR mentions 'workaround' OR issue has reproduction steps provided

status.label: status/draft
status.rule: PR is in draft state (GitHub PR.draft == true)

status.label: status/needs-repro
status.rule: type is bug AND no reproduction steps detected in body

status.label: status/stale
status.rule: no activity (comment, commit, edit) for 30+ days (cron sweep only)

ai_fallback_config.description: When deterministic rules can't classify, falls back to local LLM.
triggers: Priority escalation detected from conversation (cron sweep re-evaluates)
